decisions.reason: The stacking tray remains a proven extension of the core pallet display range and aligns with established customer demand.
The online customer portal is distant from the firm's display-focused core and has not shown sufficient integration or prominence to justify continued resources.
Winning the Deutscher Verpackungspreis validates the packaging display solution and strengthens its market position.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display fits the established product range and its dedicated product page indicates active support.
The small counter display is close to core point-of-sale offerings and likely serves recurring retail demand.
The large freestanding information display complements the existing cardboard display portfolio and has a dedicated product page.
